Theorem
[Existence of rotationally symmetric neckpinch] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0388, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0389 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-rotationally-symmetric-flow 1. appD:D.11\group Rotational Neckpinches

There is an open set of rotationally symmetric metrics on $S^n$ having a sufficiently pinched neck, positive scalar and spherical sectional curvature, and positive Ricci curvature on both polar caps, whose Ricci flows develop a finite-time Type I neckpinch. If $\bar s(t)$ is the smallest neck, then in \[ |s-\bar s|\leq 2\sqrt{(T-t)\log (1/(T-t))} \] one has, uniformly as $t\nearrow T$, \[ 1+o(1)\leq \frac{f}{\sqrt{2(n-2)(T-t)}} \leq 1+C\frac{(s-\bar s)^2}{(T-t)\log (1/(T-t))}, \] and the corresponding intermediate-region estimate is \[ \frac f{\sqrt{T-t}}\leq C\frac{s-\bar s}{\sqrt{(T-t)\log (1/(T-t))}} \sqrt{\log \left(\frac{|s-\bar s|}{\sqrt{(T-t)\log (1/(T-t))}}\right)}. \]
